people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?
translations.bsb: Consider the people of Israel: Are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar?
translations.kjv: Behold Israel after the flesh: are ➔ not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
translations.asv: Behold Israel after the flesh: have not they that eat the sacrifices communion with the altar?
